Add a link to an APK or a file, or the address a computer gives you when it shares a folder.
Live Activities are off for Husk, so downloads don't show on the Lock Screen or in the Dynamic Island. Turn them on in Settings › Husk › Live Activities.
An APK is added to your library when it finishes. Anything else goes into the Shared Storage folder, which games see as their phone storage.

serve-folder.py is in Husk's repository, under tools. The folder's contents land at the top of Shared Storage, so serve the folder that holds what a game expects there.
